scope: Headless Edge screenshots of own localhost canvas, not native Godot, real Unit, PCK, full sequence, performance or production acceptance.
observations: Horse body is one exact bitmap and one transform for all eight states; muzzle/tail/hooves no longer redraw per phase.
Rider remains fixed in scale and registered at a provisional seat/waist proxy. Visible foot/robe motion and rear hand/arm occlusion still need temporal/native scrutiny.
Independent imagegen-painted leather ribbons connect bit to moving rein hand, avoiding translating the whole rider to touch a static rein.
Sheathed states have one solid hilt in the back scabbard; drawn point/reaction states have one held sword and empty scabbard.
Reach v2 rear arm and partial draw improve continuity; enlarged fingers/occlusion and the complete draw/return trajectory are not accepted.
Partial draw to fully pointed sword still needs complete intermediate/return motion validation, not an automatic seamless-sequence pass.
